extDescription.message: Ikariam overview of every facet, map, automations and custom advisor images.

cmdToggleOverlay.message: Show or hide the IkaDios panel

renderError.message: This tab could not be drawn. Check the console for details.

pending_military.message: Open the military advisor so IkaDios can read troop movements.

pending_research.message: Open the research advisor so IkaDios can read your research.

pending_diplomacy.message: Open the diplomacy advisor so IkaDios can read messages and treaties.

pending_espionage.message: Open your hideouts so IkaDios can read your spies.

pending_trade.message: Open a trading post and search the market so IkaDios can read the offers.

pending_islands.message: Visit your islands so IkaDios can read resources and wonders.

pending_map.message: The map arrives in a later version.

emptySummary.message: No data yet. Play normally: IkaDios fills in as you open your cities.

emptyPolis.message: Open each of your cities once to see its buildings here.

hintPolis.message: * marks the capital. With several buildings of a type, the lowest level is shown.

optPacksIntro.message: Replace the four advisor images in the game. A pack holds one image per advisor and state, and can be exported to share it.

optDropHere.message: Or drop a pack .json file here

optEditorHint.message: Click a square to choose an image. Missing states use the normal image. Images are scaled down to 256 px; GIFs keep their animation.

optDebugHint.message: Only needed so IkaDios can learn new game screens. Choose what to record and for how long; it switches itself off.

optConfirmDeleteAccount.message: Delete all stored data for this account?

optNoAccounts.message: No accounts yet. Open the game to start.

packErrNotObject.message: the file is not a pack

packErrNotJson.message: the file is not valid JSON

packErrVersion.message: pack made by a newer version

packErrImageType.message: unsupported image type (use PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF)

popupNoGameTab.message: Open an Ikariam world tab to use IkaDios.

popupReloadTab.message: Reload the game tab to activate IkaDios.

refreshHint.message: Loads every city, building and advisor view once, starting with what has no data or is oldest, in varied order with irregular pauses. It runs in the background, even with the game tab closed, and only when you click it or auto mode is on.

autoRefreshHint.message: Repeat "Refresh all" automatically every ~{min} minutes (varies at random), in the background while Chrome is open, even without the game tab. Change the interval in Settings.

autoPausedErrors.message: Refresh stopped: several views failed (session expired or captcha?). Log in to the game and click "Refresh all" to resume.

optAutoRefreshHint.message: Each run waits this long on average, plus or minus 30%. Shorter intervals mean more requests and more risk with the game rules.

refreshUnavailable.message: Could not reach the extension. Reload this page (F5) after reloading IkaDios.

extensionReloaded.message: IkaDios was updated. Reload the page (F5) to keep using it.

polisCostUnknown.message: Upgrade cost not captured yet. Open the building or use "Refresh all".

polisCanUpgrade.message: Enough resources for the next level

polisDowngradeHint.message: Opens the game's demolition window, where you confirm it. It cannot be undone.

polisNotEnough.message: Not enough resources in this city

polisStockUnknown.message: This city's resources have not been captured yet. Open the city or use "Refresh all".

polisBlocked.message: Not available: {building} is being upgraded in this city

optDiscordIntro.message: Send alerts and summaries to your alliance's Discord. Create a webhook in Channel settings > Integrations > Webhooks and paste its URL. Anyone with the URL can post to that channel, so keep it private.

optWebhookTestOk.message: Test message sent. Check the channel.

optWebhookInvalid.message: That is not a Discord webhook URL.

discordAttackBody.message: The military advisor of {player} ({world}) reports an attack. Check the game now.

discordTestBody.message: This channel will receive the messages you enabled.

discordNoWebhook.message: No webhook with manual sends. Set one up in Settings > Discord.

optSoonHint.message: Arrives with a later version; you can assign the channel now.

optDebugViewsHint.message: Comma-separated view names. When set, only these are recorded and the groups above are ignored.

diplomacyPrivacy.message: Only sender, subject and date are kept, plus a short excerpt shown on hover. Messages are never sent to Discord.

alert_attack.message: Attack under way! Check the military advisor.

alert_goldLowDetail.message: Gold running out: {gold} gold now, losing {rate} per hour, runs out in {time}

alert_garrisonOver.message: {city}: {total} troops over the garrison limit of {limit}

optAlertsIntro.message: Alerts appear in the Summary tab and on the minimized panel badge. Warnings and urgent ones can also show as desktop notifications.

mapError.message: The world map could not be loaded (ika-map.com). Try "Reload map".

mapReloadHint.message: Download the world again from ika-map.com (normally cached for 6 hours).

mapSearchHint.message: Search up to five players or alliances; each one gets its color on the map.

islandsHint.message: Resources, wonder and neighbours come from ika-map.com; islands you open in the game add their name, wonder level and running upgrades.

layerPaintHint.message: Mark islands on the map with a color and a label

layerPaintHelp.message: Click or drag over islands; click a marked island to erase it.

layerImportFailed.message: That file is not an IkaDios map layer.

layerNoWebhook.message: No webhook receives map layers. Enable "War map layers" in Settings > Discord.

tradeListingTitle.message: Ask or offer resources to the alliance (Discord)

tradeListingExchangePlaceholder.message: In exchange (optional): e.g. 20.000 marble or 9 gold per unit

tradeListingNoWebhook.message: No webhook receives trade listings for this city. Enable "Trade offers and requests" in Settings > Discord.

polisAskAllianceHint.message: Opens the Trade tab with the missing resources, ready to send to Discord

tradeListingSendHint.message: With IkaDios the game transport window opens with the amounts filled in; without it, the transport window to this city.

deliverySent.message: Sent to the game. Check the transport in the military advisor.

deliveryError_form.message: the transport window did not open for these cities

deliveryHint.message: Check the player and destination before sending: anyone can create a link. The game window opens, IkaDios fills the amounts and presses the game's send button; the game applies its usual checks.

deliveryShipsShort.message: About {n} merchant ships needed but only {free} are free.

discordNoResponse.message: The extension did not answer. Reload IkaDios in chrome://extensions and this page (F5).

deliveryPrefillFailed.message: The game transport window could not be prepared ({reason}). You can send from here.

researchExpHint.message: Experiments are done in an academy; after each one the scientists need {hours} h before the next. Red: not enough crystal in your cities.

researchExpPending.message: Open an academy (or use "Refresh all") so IkaDios can read the experiment cost.

deliveryModePanel.message: Deliver from the Trade panel when opening a delivery link

deliveryModeHint.message: Checked: links from Discord open the pending delivery panel here. Unchecked: they open the game transport window with the amounts filled in.

deliveryError_sameCity.message: the city selected in the game is the destination; select another of your cities

deliveryError_cityChange.message: could not switch to the origin city in the game

deliveryProblemOrigin.message: Choose the city to send from.

deliveryProblemStock.message: {resource}: {amount} requested but the city only has {stock}.

deliveryError_noAnswer.message: the game did not confirm the transport (it may have stopped it in its own window)

polisActionError_unavailable.message: The action could not be sent. Reload the page (F5) and try again.

polisActionError_cityChange.message: Could not switch to that city in the game.

polisActionError_noAnswer.message: The game did not answer the upgrade request.

shareWhatsAppHint.message: Opens WhatsApp with the same message (and the delivery link); choose your alliance group and send.

shareWhatsAppOpened.message: WhatsApp opened: choose the group and send.

mapOpenHint.message: Double click an island to open it in the game.

mapShareNoLayers.message: No visible layers with marks: only the image is shared.

mapShareImportLink.message: Open and import the layers in IkaDios

mapShareFileNote.message: The layers are too many for a link: import the attached file from the Map tab ("Import layer").

mapShareWhatsAppOpened.message: WhatsApp opened with the link. WhatsApp cannot attach the image from a link: use "Copy image" and paste it in the chat.

mapShareCopied.message: Image copied: paste it with Ctrl+V.

mapImportHint.message: They are added as new layers; your own layers are not changed.

mapImportTitle_one.message: {player} shared {n} map layer ({islands} islands). Import it?

mapImportTitle_other.message: {player} shared {n} map layers ({islands} islands). Import them?

mapShareWhat_one.message: Shares the map image as you see it and a link with the {n} visible layer ({islands} islands).

mapShareWhat_other.message: Shares the map image as you see it and a link with the {n} visible layers ({islands} islands).

layerFromTextPlaceholder.message:
Paste coordinates, e.g.
target: [47:20], [48:17]
do not touch: [50:21]

layerFromTextHint.message: A line that starts with "label:" uses that label for its islands. Expiry comes from the paint brush.

discordLayerPasteHint.message: Too many islands for a link: copy this message and use "Create layer from text" in the IkaDios map.

autoWarning.message: Automations go against Ikariam's rules and can get the account banned. Everything is off until you enable it; you take the risk.

autoStopped_session.message: Stopped: the game session expired. Log in again and turn automations back on.

autoStopped_captcha.message: Stopped: the game asked for a security code. Solve it in the game and turn automations back on.

autoBuildHint.message: Each city works through its active tasks in order. A task waits until the city has the resources and no other construction, then upgrades one level at a time up to the target level. Inactive tasks are skipped. Every task is checked at least once per interval; Run now checks it right away.

autoNoCities.message: No city buildings known yet. Open your cities in the game or use Refresh all.

autoAddError_duplicate.message: That building already has a task.

autoMsg_busy.message: Another construction in progress, checking again at {when}

autoMsg_noBuilding.message: The building is no longer there

autoMsg_buildingChanged.message: There is another building in that position

autoMsg_costUnknown.message: Could not read the upgrade cost

autoLog_simulated.message: {building} in {city}: would upgrade from level {level} to {next}

autoLog_upgradeSent.message: {building} in {city}: upgrade from level {level} to {next} started

autoLog_gameError.message: {building} in {city}: the game rejected the upgrade

autoLog_requestFailed.message: {building} in {city}: the game did not answer

autoLog_noBuilding.message: {building} in {city}: the building is no longer there

autoLog_buildingChanged.message: {building} in {city}: there is another building in that position

autoLog_stopped_captcha.message: Stopped: the game asked for a security code

autoLog_taskChanged.message: Task changed: {building} in {city}, up to level {to}

autoMsg_rateLimit.message: Limit of 20 actions per hour reached, waiting until {when}

autoRunNowError_busy.message: Another check is running, try again in a moment.

autoRunNowError_refreshing.message: Refresh all is running, try again when it finishes.

autoRunNowError_session.message: The game session expired. Log in again.

autoRunNowError_captcha.message: The game asked for a security code. Solve it in the game.

autoActiveHint.message: Unchecked: the task is kept but does nothing until you activate it

autoCheckHint.message: Between {min} and {max} minutes. Each check that reads the game makes 2 to 4 requests.

polisAutoActiveHint.message: Checked: upgrades when the resources are there, and switches automations on. Unchecked: the task is kept but inactive.

polisAutoSavedActive.message: Saved. It will upgrade when the resources are there.

polisAutoSavedInactive.message: Saved as inactive: it does nothing until you activate it.

autoTransportHint.message: Ships from the origin city to another of your cities. Fixed amount: sends exactly that, once or every N hours, when the origin has it all. Fill: keeps the destination at least at those amounts, counting cargo already on the way, and sends what the origin and the free ships allow.

autoTransportSameCity.message: Origin and destination must be different.

autoMsg_missingOrigin.message: The origin has nothing to send, checking again at {when}

autoMsg_noShips.message: No free merchant ships, checking again at {when}

autoMsg_satisfied.message: The destination already has enough, checking again at {when}

autoMsg_dataUnknown.message: Could not read the city data

autoMsg_formMissing.message: Could not read the transport window

autoMsg_noCity.message: One of the cities is no longer yours

autoLog_transportError.message: Transport {from} to {to}: the game rejected it

autoLog_noCity.message: Transport {from} to {to}: one of the cities is no longer yours

autoStartHint.message: Empty: as soon as possible. Repeats count from the first send. If the time falls in the quiet hours, it is sent when they end.

autoStartPast.message: That date and time have already passed.

spyReportsHint.message: Open the hideout's Reports or Archive tab in the game and IkaDios reads them.

refreshTabHint.message: Loads again only the game views behind "{tab}", in the background with random pauses

battlesNone.message: No battles known. Open the war reports in the game or use Refresh tab.

battleNoReport.message: (the game did not return the report text)

battlesHint.message: Battles in progress come from your movements in combat; finished ones from the war reports.

battleImportHint.message: Paste a report copied from the game's battle report converter (plain text or BBCode), yours or one shared by another player, or one or more IkaDios battle links (they include the rounds).

battleImportInvalid.message: That does not look like a battle report from the game's converter.

battleRoundsNone.message: The game did not return the rounds of this battle.

battleSideGone.message: No troops left on the field.

mapShipEstimated.message: Estimated position (standard travel time; departure not seen)

mapLegendShipMarker.message: Ship marker with a dark border: exact position; white border: estimated.

playerSearchHint.message: Type a player's name to see their cities, levels, distance from your cities, your spy reports and battles about them, and your notes.

playerNoCities.message: No cities for this player in the world data (ika-map.com, updated every few hours).

playerTravelHint.message: Standard travel time for merchant ships, from your nearest city

playerNoSpyReports.message: No spy reports on this player.

intelHint.message: Nothing is imported without confirming. What others share never replaces your own data.

planOpenLink.message: Open the plan in IkaDios (works out your departure times)

planSpeedHint.message: Travel minutes per distance unit. 20 is the standard for merchant ships; adjust it to your troops or warships.

planNone.message: No plans. Create one or open the link of a shared plan.

shareAllianceHint.message: Posts to the alliance bot channel; the other members' IkaDios import it by themselves

optAllianceIntro.message: Optional. With a Discord bot of your alliance, IkaDios posts to a private channel and reads what the other members post: reports, player notes, attack plans and map layers are imported by themselves. Ask your leader for the bot token and the channel ID.

optAllianceTokenStored.message: (stored; type a new one to change it)

optAllianceAutoPlans.message: Post the attack plans I create

optAllianceAutoNotes.message: Post my player notes when I save them

optAllianceSecurity.message: The token is stored on this computer and only sent to Discord. Anyone with the token can read and write in the channel as the bot: share it only with trusted members. If it leaks, the leader regenerates it in the Discord portal.

optAllianceIncomplete.message: The token or the channel ID is missing, or the bot is off.

optAllianceBadToken.message: Discord rejected the token (401). Check that it is the bot token.

optAllianceNoAccess.message: The bot cannot see that channel (403). Check that the bot is in the server and has View Channel and Read Message History in that channel.

optAllianceMissingPermissions.message: The bot sees the channel but lacks permissions (403). Give it Send Messages, Embed Links and Attach Files in that channel.

optAllianceBlocked.message: Discord blocked the request (403, code 40333). Update IkaDios and reload it in the extensions page; if it persists, try without VPN or proxy.

optAllianceNoChannel.message: That channel does not exist or the ID is not valid.

alliancePlanMessage.message: Target [{x}:{y}], arrival {when}. Open it in Military to see your departure times.

allianceIntro.message: What the alliance shares through IkaDios: each member's status, resource requests (with "I will send it" so nothing is sent twice) and attack plans.

allianceNoBot.message: The alliance bot is not set up. Requests and plans arriving by links show up anyway, but "I will send it", confirmations and member status need the bot.

allianceNotReadYet.message: The channel has not been read yet.

alliancePublishStatusHint.message: Posts your free merchant ships, troops, warships, incoming attacks and gold to the channel (replaces your previous status)

allianceNoMembers.message: No member has posted a status yet ("Post my status" in the bot options).

allianceNoRequests.message: No requests. Trade requests sent to Discord or to the bot show up here.

allianceClaimNeedsBot.message: "I will send it" needs the alliance bot; you can deliver without it.

allianceStatusTitle.message: Status of {player}: {ships} free merchant ships, {units} troops, {hostile} incoming attacks

allianceRequestLink.message: Add to the alliance requests (with "I will send it")

planConfirmNeedsBot.message: Confirmations travel through the alliance bot (set it up in the options).

optAllianceAutoStatus.message: Post my status every so often

mapMoveHostileHint.message: Solid red line, pulsing ring on the target.

mapMovesLines.message: Solid line: attack. Long dashes: troops. Short dashes: trade. Dots: other.

layerFromWorldHint.message: Marks every island where that player or alliance has a city, in the chosen color. Islands shared with another visible layer are split into one stripe per layer. Use the update button of the layer to refresh it with newer world data.

mapLegendFlags.message: Marked islands: green corner (top right) = members of your alliance live there; gold corner (top left) = you do.
